description.zh: 排程描述，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一。
description.en: The description of the schedule. It must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters. The description must be unique within the instance.

description.zh: 排程结束工作日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd，不得早于StartDate。
description.en: The end date of the schedule, in yyyy-MM-dd format. This date cannot be earlier than the StartDate.

description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the call will fail.
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh: 排程名称，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一。
description.en: The name of the schedule. It must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters. The name must be unique within the instance.

description.zh:
排程开放类型。

- 内部（默认）：取值为**INNER**，只允许排程所在实例下的设备请求声码解码。

- 公开：取值为**OPEN**，可以发送邮件的方式配置白名单，允许跨实例的设备请求声码解码，跨实例解码的用量计算在声码所在的实例下。
description.en:
The openness type of the schedule.

- Internal (default): Set to **INNER**. Only devices under the same instance as the schedule can request sound code decoding.

- Public: Set to **OPEN**. You can configure a whitelist via email to allow devices from other instances to request sound code decoding. Usage for cross-instance decoding is billed to the instance where the sound code resides.

description.zh: 排程开始工作日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd。
description.en: The start date of the schedule, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为2。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 2.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-sound-code-schedule --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --name test --description test --start-date 2022-03-31 --end-date 2022-03-31 --open-type INNER --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot CreateSoundCodeSchedule --region cn-hangzhou --StartDate '2022-03-31' --OpenType INNER --Description test --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --EndDate '2022-03-31' --Name test
